signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
  (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T P : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), Matrix.det (P k) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), P (k + 1) = P k * T k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), V (k + 1) = V k * T k + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k)) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          R.normalizedFrameEnergy V P (k + 1) =
            R.normalizedFrameEnergy V P k -
                BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((P k)⁻¹.transpose.mulVec ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) / R.q k +
              BfgsVerification.sqNorm
                  ((P (k + 1))⁻¹.transpose.mulVec ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k))) /
                R.curvature k

∀ {n : ℕ} (M : BfgsVerification.Mat n),
  Matrix.PosSemidef M →
    ∀ (s : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      Matrix.mulVec M s = 0 →
        ∀ (W Z : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (a : ℝ),
          (a •
                  (BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s * W *
                    BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s) -
                BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s * Z *
                  BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s).PosSemidef →
            (M * Z).trace ≤ a * (M * W).trace

∀ {n : ℕ} (W : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (s v : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.metricEnergy
      (BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s * W *
        BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s)
      v =
    BfgsVerification.metricEnergy W (Matrix.mulVec (BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s) v)

∀ {L c₁ d fx fz fstar : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L → 0 < c₁ → c₁ * d ≤ fx - fz → Real.exp (L / c₁ * (fz - fstar)) * (1 + L * d) ≤ Real.exp (L / c₁ * (fx - fstar))
